Right, quick update on the reporting thing.

We're not doing the eighteen month plan. It costs a fortune and we'd be running
two platforms the whole time. Bin it.

The December weekend idea is worse. One bad Saturday and January reporting is
gone. Nobody's signing up for that.

So here's what we're doing. Move the archive first. Check it actually works.
Then move the live reporting. If the archive check goes badly we stop there and
we've lost a week, not a quarter.

Three things I need from you:

- names for the workshop by Friday
- a rough headcount for the archive move
- anyone who thinks this is wrong, tell me now, not in November

On the archive move specifically. Sam reckons we can do it in a fortnight. I
think that's optimistic but it's his call and he knows the data better than I
do. Give him what he asks for.

The thing that worries me isn't the migration. It's that nobody has looked at
the old reconciliation scripts in about three years and they're going to fall
over the moment we touch anything. Someone needs to own that. Volunteers
welcome, otherwise I'm picking someone.

One more thing. We keep saying we'll document this properly and then we don't.
Write it down as you go. Not a big document. A page. Enough that the next person
doesn't have to reverse engineer it from the logs.

That's it. Shout if something here is wrong.
